name: io.github.Nutshell2000/agent-data-tools-utilities
title: Agent Data Tools: Utilities
description: 109 tools: JSON repair, CSV, hashes, cron, dates, units, validators. 10 free calls.

tools.name: csv_preflight
tools.description:
Check CSV text before importing: returns a verdict (ok), problems with line numbers (empty or missing header, no data rows, ragged rows with field counts, duplicate headers, mixed column types, unterminated quotes, mojibake), the detected delimiter and a per-column type report. Use before ingesting a CSV export. Example: text=name,age
Ada,36
Bob,41. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

text.description: The CSV text to validate (first row is the header)

tools.name: memory_set
tools.description: Save a value (up to 8,000 characters of text or JSON) under a key in your own namespace, so an agent can remember facts, preferences or task state between runs. Overwrites an existing key; expires after 1 to 30 days (default 30). Values are kept until they expire (at most 30 days) or are deleted; reads anywhere may lag a write made elsewhere by up to a minute. Use to persist what an agent learned for a later call to memory_get. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Changes only what you saved in your own memory namespace; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

namespace.description: Your namespace: a secret of 16 to 128 letters, digits, - or _ that you choose and reuse. Anyone who knows it can read and write it, so treat it like a password; send it in a POST body to keep it out of URLs.

value.description: The text or JSON to save, up to 8,000 characters

tools.name: memory_get
tools.description: Read the value saved under a key in your namespace with /memory/set, with when it was saved and when it expires. A key that was never saved or has expired is a 422 and is not charged. Values are kept until they expire (at most 30 days) or are deleted; reads anywhere may lag a write made elsewhere by up to a minute. Use to recall what an agent saved in an earlier run. Example: namespace=demo-agent-memory-7f3c9a21, key=user-preferences. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

namespace.description: Your namespace: a secret of 16 to 128 letters, digits, - or _ that you choose and reuse. Anyone who knows it can read and write it, so treat it like a password; send it in a POST body to keep it out of URLs.

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Describe a task in plain words and compare up to five paid APIs for it across the whole Coinbase Bazaar: each pick with the exact URL to call, method, price in USD, networks, 30-day payers and calls, last paid date and the evidence behind the order. Our own listings are marked, never boosted. No matching tool means no charge. Use when an agent must choose which API to call before paying one. Example: need=check whether a Base token is a honeypot. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

need.description: The task in plain words, 3 to 300 characters

maxPrice.description: Only listings at or under this price in USD

networks.description: Comma-separated networks: base, polygon, arbitrum, solana

tools.name: pack_hash_toolbox
tools.description: Every common hash of one input in a single call: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, Keccak-256 (Ethereum), CRC-32, base64 SHA-256, and Subresource Integrity strings (sha256-, sha384-, sha512-) for <script integrity>. Hashes UTF-8 text, or 0x/hex bytes with hex=true. Cheaper than hashing one algorithm at a time. Use for checksums, cache keys, file integrity and comparing digests across systems. Example: text=hello world. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

text.description: Text to hash (up to 100,000 characters), or hex bytes with hex=true

hex.description: true to treat text as hex bytes (0x prefix optional)

tools.name: pack_json_toolbox
tools.description: Everything about one JSON document in a single call: valid or not with the error's line and column, pretty-printed (optionally with sorted keys), minified with the bytes saved, an inferred JSON Schema, structure statistics (depth, objects, arrays, keys, value types) and the same data as YAML. Up to 200 KB. Cheaper than the separate JSON tools. Use to inspect API responses, clean model output or document a payload. Example: json={"name":"agent","tools":["weather","search"],"active":true,"limits":{"daily":100}}. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

sortKeys.description: true to sort object keys in the formatted output

tools.name: pack_encoding_toolbox
tools.description: Every common encoding of one text in a single call: Base64 and Base64url, hex, URL component and full-URL encoding, HTML-escaped, ROT13, Unicode code points, UTF-8 byte count and Punycode for international domain names, plus automatic decoding when the input already looks like Base64, hex, URL or HTML encoding. Use to prepare data for headers, URLs and markup, or to work out what an encoded string says. Example: text=Café & <tags>. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: pack_text_analysis
tools.description: One call to analyse a text: length, reading time and readability grade, the top keywords and repeated phrases with their density, the emails, links, phone numbers, hashtags and mentions it contains, and a prompt-injection scan for text an agent is about to act on. Up to 20,000 characters, local processing. Cheaper than the four tools bought one by one. Use to review drafts, triage inbound messages or vet scraped content. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: pack_id_toolbox
tools.description: Generate unique IDs of every common kind in one call: UUID v4 (random), UUID v7 and ULID (time-ordered, sort by creation), NanoID (21 URL-safe characters) and random base62 and hex strings, up to 20 of each, from the platform's cryptographic random source; and decode the creation time hidden in a ULID or UUID v7. Use for database keys, request and trace IDs, file names or test data. Example: count=3. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

decode.description: Optional ULID or UUID to read the timestamp from

tools.name: pack_string_toolbox
tools.description: Transform one string every common way at once: camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE, dot.case, path/case, Title Case, Sentence case, upper and lower; a URL slug (accents removed); reversed; trimmed and whitespace-collapsed; and counts of characters, letters, digits, words and lines. Splits identifiers like userIDValue or XMLHttpRequest correctly. Use when naming fields, files and routes or cleaning user input. Example: text=Hello World, user profile ID 42. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: text_language
tools.description: Language detection for a text: the most likely language with its ISO 639-3 and 639-1 codes and English name, plus the next candidates with relative scores, using trigram statistics for 82 major languages (franc-min). Works best above about 20 characters; very short or mixed text returns und (undetermined). Local, no outside service. Use to route messages, pick a translation target or filter content by language. Example: text=Det här är en mening skriven på svenska om väder och resor.. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: useragent_parse
tools.description: Parse a User-Agent string into browser and version, operating system and version, device type (desktop, mobile, tablet or bot) and, for crawlers, which bot it is: Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, social previewers, SEO crawlers and HTTP libraries such as curl or python-requests. Local rules, no outside service. Use to read access logs, segment traffic or spot AI crawlers. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: answers_page_evidence
tools.description: One call for one public URL: fetch the page as clean text, grade its HTTP security headers, and return a SHA-256 of the extracted text with a receipt naming the URL, the result hash and the payment terms, Ed25519-signed with our published key. The hash covers the text as read, not the page's raw bytes. Use when an agent needs citable evidence that a page said something at a point in time. Failures are never charged; nulls are never guesses. Example: url=https://example.com. Price $0.05/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: answers_company_diligence
tools.description: One call for one company domain: site identity, tech stack, email provider and email security, hosting, DNS and registration age, plus a sanctions-list screen (OFAC, EU, UN, UK) of the domain's own name, the label before the first dot. No company register is read. Use when an agent must vet a counterparty's website before dealing with it: one answer with a signed receipt and per-section failures. Public sources only; no private data. Example: domain=stripe.com. Price $0.05/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: search_similar
tools.description: Find pages like a given URL: we read it, search on its title and topic words and return the top 1-20 similar pages (title, URL, snippet, date), leaving out the source site by default. Same filters and contents options as /search (page text, highlights, summaries). Results are for immediate use only (Brave API terms). Use to find competitors, related articles or alternatives to a page. Example: url=https://www.x402.org/. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

url.description: The page to find similar pages for

excludeSourceDomain.description: Leave out the source page's whole domain (default true)

includeDomains.description: Only results from these domains: comma list or JSON array, up to 20 (example.com, github.com/org)

excludeDomains.description: Never results from these domains: comma list or JSON array

startPublishedDate.description: Only pages published on or after this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2025-01-01)

endPublishedDate.description: Only pages published on or before this date (ISO 8601)

category.description: news, research paper, github, pdf, tweet, linkedin profile, company, personal site or financial report

includeText.description: A phrase the results must contain (up to 5 words)

excludeText.description: A phrase the results must not contain

country.description: Localize results for this country: 2-letter code (SE, DE, FR, GB, US…)

textChars.description: Return the live page text of the top results, this many characters each (500-20000, or true for 3000; default none)

highlights.description: true: the passages of each page that best match the query, with scores

summary.description: true: a 1-3 sentence AI summary of each of the top pages

summaryQuery.description: What the summaries should focus on (default: the query)

tools.name: keywords_ideas
tools.description: Keyword ideas for SEO and ads: the search phrases real users type for a seed keyword, from Google, Bing, YouTube, Amazon and DuckDuckGo autocomplete, deduplicated and ranked by how many engines suggest each, with question and buying-intent phrases listed apart. deep=true adds the Google long tail (seed + a-z, how, what, best, vs), up to 200 keywords. Use to plan content, find long-tail and question keywords, or name a product. No search volumes. Example: seed=crm software. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

deep.description: true to add the Google long tail (seed + each letter, question words); about 30 more lookups

engines.description: Optional comma list: google, bing, youtube, amazon, duckduckgo (default all)

country.description: Country code (default us); Amazon suggestions come from that country's store where one exists

tools.name: x402_find
tools.description: Find pay-per-call x402 APIs for a task across the whole Coinbase Bazaar: up to 20 listings with name, URL, method, price in USD, networks, 30-day payers and calls, and when each was last paid for, in the Bazaar's relevance order or sorted by use or price, with a price cap and an active-only filter. Our own listings are marked, never boosted. Use when an agent needs a paid tool it does not have yet. Example: q=email verification. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

q.description: The task or tool to find, in words

maxPrice.description: Only listings at or under this price in USD

network.description: Only listings that accept this network: base, polygon, arbitrum, solana…

active.description: true: only listings paid for in the last 30 days

tools.name: evidence_bundle
tools.description: Turn a settled x402 payment into a signed bundle: the on-chain receipt with canonical text and SHA-256, the price the same host and path advertise on the Coinbase Bazaar and whether it matched, plus explicit limits. Signed with our Ed25519 key and issued in our name, whoever the seller is. It does NOT prove what was delivered. Failed lookups return partial evidence with errors. Use before approving a payment or closing an agent's books. Example: hash=0x778c8c1b1fd1b320bf045eae0af7274e74a9e2e1f83c34ec96d9f825aea3b933. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

hash.description: Transaction hash of the payment (0x, 64 hex characters)

chain.description: Network: base (default), eth, arb, op or polygon

payTo.description: Optional: the payee, when the transaction holds several USDC transfers

resource.description: Optional: the URL the payment bought, checked against the catalog price

Use before parsing an LLM's or an API's output. Example: text={"a":1}. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

text.description: The JSON text to check (up to 20,000 characters)

tools.name: json_format
tools.description: Format JSON with indentation (2 or 4 spaces, or tabs) and optionally sorted keys. Returns the formatted text. Use to make machine JSON readable or to normalise it for diffs. Example: text={"b":2,"a":1}. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: json_minify
tools.description: Remove all unnecessary whitespace from JSON and report the size before and after. Use to shrink payloads or prompts. Example: text={ "a" : 1 }. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

json_to_csv

Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.description: Compute an HMAC of a message with a key using SHA-256 (default), SHA-1, SHA-384 or SHA-512, in hex and base64. Use to check webhook signatures. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: uuid

Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

Line-by-line difference between two texts: each line marked as unchanged, removed or added, with counts. Use to see what changed between two versions of a document, config or prompt. Example: a=one

tools.description: Flip one or more fair coins using a cryptographic random source. Returns each result and the totals. Use for fair decisions and games. Example: count=1. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: dice
tools.description: Roll dice in standard notation such as 2d6+3 or 1d20, up to 100 dice of up to 1000 sides, with a cryptographic random source. Returns every roll, the modifier and the total. Use for tabletop games and simulations. Example: roll=2d6+3. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: random_number
tools.description: One or more random whole numbers in a range (inclusive), optionally all different, from a cryptographic random source. Use for draws, sampling and games. Example: min=1. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: random_pick
tools.description: Pick one or more items at random (without repeats) from a comma- or line-separated list. Use for raffles, choosing who goes first, or breaking ties fairly. Example: items=Ada,Alan,Grace,Linus. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: random_shuffle
tools.description: Shuffle a comma- or line-separated list into a random order (Fisher-Yates with a cryptographic random source). Use for draw orders, seating and playlists. Example: items=1,2,3,4,5. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: random_teams

tools.name: magic_8_ball
tools.description: Fortune teller: ask a yes-or-no question and get one of the 20 classic Magic 8-Ball answers, chosen at random (Signs point to yes, Very doubtful, and so on). A light fortune-telling novelty for games and chat bots, not a prediction. Use when you want a playful fortune or an 8-ball answer. Example: question=Will it ship today?. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

tools.name: fortune
tools.description: Random fortune: get one short fortune-cookie saying chosen at random with a cryptographic source, with no input needed. For fun only; a fortune is not a prediction. Use for games, chat bots and a light daily message. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
